provenance.note: DISCONFIRMATION PROBE (reserve-where-proof-is-cheap). Solutions are auto-judged, so correctness is nearly free to prove — yet AI is reserved. What the rating certifies is the human competitor reasoning, whose proof is scarce: the split on proof-of-what holds (4th arrival after NetBSD). D1=2: public timestamped pre-publication as provenance proof. D3=1: URL citation required but explicitly no need to disclose AI use for pre-published code. Twilight true: rules pegged to capabilities as of October 2026, to be modified as AI changes. Trust-bearing: ratings marketed to employers (AtCoderJobs).
